requirements.summary: Create a product catalog display showing multiple products with images, names, prices, and brief descriptions in a grid layout
acceptanceCriteria: Products are displayed in a responsive grid layout
Each product card shows an image, name, price, and description
Layout adapts to different screen sizes

file_operations.description: Create a ProductCard component that displays a single product with image, name, price, and description. Use Tailwind CSS for styling with responsive design patterns. Component accepts a Product prop matching the backend Product interface.
Create a ProductGrid component that renders an array of ProductCard components in a responsive grid layout using Tailwind CSS grid utilities. Handles empty state when no products are available.

Create the main catalog page that integrates ProductGrid and filtering sidebar. Manages product data fetching and filter state. Wire the generated hero banner image at frontend/public/assets/generated/hero-banner.dim_1200x400.png into the page header.
Update the main App component to include routing for the CatalogPage as the default route. Remove placeholder content and establish the catalog as the primary view.

requirements.summary: Implement a filtering sidebar with options for category, price range, and rating to help shoppers make quick decisions
acceptanceCriteria: Filtering sidebar is visible and accessible
Users can filter by category using checkboxes or buttons
Users can filter by price range using a slider or input fields
Users can filter by rating selection
Product grid updates immediately when filters are applied

file_operations.description: Create a FilterSidebar component with category checkboxes, price range inputs, and rating selection controls. Emits filter changes to parent component. Uses shadcn/ui components for interactive elements where appropriate.

Create a custom hook that manages filter state and calls backend query methods (getProductsByCategory, getProductsByPriceRange, getProductsByRating) from the backend interface. Combines multiple filters and handles the logic for applying them.

Integrate FilterSidebar component into CatalogPage layout. Connect useProductFilters hook to manage filter state and update ProductGrid with filtered results. Implement responsive layout with sidebar and main content area.

requirements.summary: Apply a modern, clean visual design theme with a professional e-commerce aesthetic, featuring neutral tones with accent colors, clear typography for product information, and intuitive interaction patterns for filtering and browsing
acceptanceCriteria: Visual theme is consistently applied across all pages
Color scheme supports readability and hierarchy
Typography is clear and appropriate for product information
Interactive elements have clear hover and active states

file_operations.description: Update global styles to implement the e-commerce design theme. Define CSS custom properties for neutral tones with accent colors. Establish typography scale for product information, headings, and body text. Set base interactive states for buttons and links.

Extend Tailwind configuration with custom color palette for neutral tones and accent colors. Configure typography plugin settings for product-focused content. Add custom spacing and border radius values for consistent e-commerce aesthetic.

Apply consistent styling using the established theme. Implement hover states, card shadows, and transitions for professional interaction patterns. Ensure typography hierarchy for product name, price, and description.
Style the filter sidebar with theme colors and typography. Ensure clear visual feedback for selected filters and interactive controls. Apply consistent spacing and visual hierarchy.
